title: Retry of C-021: record the iPhone screen while 4 versions play (about 6 min)
instructions: Same as C-021, from the start. The phone records its own screen; the Mac camera is not used. Numbers only: no agent looks at the video without asking you first.

parts.label: Start the screen recording
parts.instructions: On the iPhone: turn on Do Not Disturb. Open Control Center, press and hold the Screen Recording button and check that Microphone is OFF. Tap Start Recording, wait for the 3-second countdown, then close Control Center. Click Done here when it is recording ("started").

parts.label: Versions 1-4 play (about 3.5 min)
parts.instructions: Click Start, then put the phone down and don't tap anything, not even Done here. I load 4 versions of the page, one after another, about 48 s each, and I end this part myself when version 4 is done (about 3.5 min).

parts.label: Stop the recording
parts.instructions: Tap the red recording indicator at the top of the iPhone screen, then Stop. Click Done.

parts.label: Move the file to the Mac
parts.instructions: AirDrop the recording from Photos to this Mac. In Finder press Shift-Cmd-G, paste this folder path: /Users/<user>/source/fastwork-com-web-optimize/.claude/worktrees/agent-afc7d9fff1fcc6154/out/pr001-visual/ and drag the recording from Downloads into it. Click Done when it is moved ("moved"). The copies in your Photos (this one and the first try's) are yours to delete.

history.note: Phone is ready again, version 1 is loaded. Start whenever you like.
Recording started, thanks. Click Start, put the phone down, and don't tap Done: I end this part in about 3.5 min.
